design.stop: First completed update reaching the forward-view budget.
design.timing: Optimizer work only. Arms share the host, one BLAS thread per physical core.
design.spring: Alternating SPRING-SARAH, practical tuned fixed steps, independent 1/16 full refresh per block.
design.proxsarah: Joint Algorithm 1 with minibatch snapshots, empirical tuned steps.
design.constraints: Nonnegative factors with separate spectral norm caps.
design.radius: Each cap equals twice the operator norm of its calibrated warm factor.
design.projection: Certified spectral-ball/orthant Dykstra with single-set reductions.
design.repair: Diagnostic positive part followed by inward radial spectral scaling.
design.signed_start: Independent Gaussian directions, mapped by one spectral LMO per block; seed base+200000.
design.reference: Mode 2 TIFF reflected into DeepInv convention and converted to per-mm attenuation.
design.inference: One development slice and two held-out evaluation slices. Pilot.
